title: Household Size and Reinstatement Extension Months
content:
Patient Services Academy — training note on **Patient Payment Plans**: how the household recorded under the Patient Financial Assistance Program adds reinstatement extension months when a defaulted plan is put back in force.

## The rule

A patient whose approved assistance case records a household of 3 or more adds 2 reinstatement extension months when the plan has no automatic payments and 1 month when it has automatic payments; any other patient adds none.

The extension months are added to the installments the reinstated balance is spread over.

The household is the household size recorded on the patient's case under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved; a patient with no approved case adds none, whatever household an application may show. Automatic payments are read from the plan's automatic-payment setting, whatever the method.

| Household on the approved case | Automatic payments on the plan | Reinstatement extension months |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | No | 2 |
| 3 or more | Yes | 1 |
| 1 or 2 | Yes or No | 0 |
| No approved case | Yes or No | 0 |

## Questions answered (hypothetical patients)

**Household of 3, plan paid manually by check?** 2 months.

**Household of 5, automatic draws by bank transfer?** 1 month.

**Household of 2, plan paid manually?** None; the household is below 3.

**An application under review shows a household of 6.** No approved case, so none.
